items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: He used to be the piano player with Lowell Fulsom.

ctx.x: Lowell Fulsom. He used to be the piano player with Lowell Fulsom.

So we got him a recording date with Atlantic as a single, and he took some off his men out of there, I guess; he got his own men and recorded. And I had the first date to book for him down in Philadelphia, at a club. And I had to get the musicians to play with him. And I made one mistake. I got the musicians from New York. I didn't know Ray Charles was a Jazz artist. Because I'd just heard the songs he was doing, but it wasn't Jazz, and I could have got the Jazz musicians in Philadelphia. Because Philadelphia had…
